business_summary: AN2 Therapeutics, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on discovering and developing novel small molecule therapeutics. The company's initial candidate includes epetraborole, which is phase 3 clinical trial as a once-daily oral treatment for patients with non-tuberculous mycobacterial lung disease, as well as studying for the treatment of acute melioidosis. It also develops AN2-502998 (AN15368), an investigational, boron-based small molecule in development for the treatment of chronic Chagas disease that is in preclinical trials; and has various research programs targeting the development of novel compounds in oncology and infectious disease based on its boron chemistry platform. It has a license agreement with Anacor Pharmaceuticals, Inc. to use, develop, manufacture, commercialize compounds and products, including epetraborole for the treatment, diagnosis, or prevention of various human diseases; and Brii Biosciences Limited to research, develop, manufacture, and commercialize compounds and products comprising epetraborole in China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Macau for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of human diseases; and GSK plc for the development of new therapies for TB. AN2 Therapeutics, Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.
business_summary_ko: 바이오의약품 회사인 AN2 Therapeutics, Inc.는 새로운 소분자 치료제 발견 및 개발에 중점을 두고 있습니다. 회사의 초기 후보에는 비결핵성 항산균성 폐질환 환자를 대상으로 1일 1회 경구 치료제로 임상 3상 시험 중인 에페트라보롤(epetraborole)과 급성 멜리오이도증 치료를 위한 연구도 포함된다. 또한 전임상 시험 중인 만성 샤가스병 치료용으로 개발 중인 연구용 붕소 기반 소분자 AN2-502998(AN15368)도 개발하고 있습니다. 붕소 화학 플랫폼을 기반으로 종양학 및 전염병 분야의 새로운 화합물 개발을 목표로 하는 다양한 연구 프로그램을 보유하고 있습니다. 다양한 인간 질병의 치료, 진단 또는 예방을 위한 에페트라보롤을 포함한 화합물 및 제품을 사용, 개발, 제조, 상업화하기 위해 Anacor Pharmaceuticals, Inc.와 라이센스 계약을 맺었습니다.
